skipped_files.description: Files skipped because coverage data could not be processed.

missing_tracked_files.description: Tracked files absent from coverage data.

newer_files.description: Sources newer than the coverage timestamp.

deleted_files.description: Coverage entries whose source files have been deleted.

length_mismatch_files.description: Files whose source line count differs from coverage data.

unreadable_files.description: Source files that could not be read.

timestamp_status.description: Whether the coverage timestamp is available.

warnings.description: Timestamp warnings; present only in MCP output when timestamp_status is missing.

file.description: Source path relative to the project root; absolute if the file is outside it.

covered.description: Lines with at least one hit.

percentage.description: Line coverage percent (covered / coverable lines), truncated to two decimals; null when there are no coverable lines.

file.description: Source path relative to the project root; absolute if the file is outside it.

items.description: Source path relative to the project root; absolute if the file is outside it.
